answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics for evaluation: 1) Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc) matches the selected element with all required elements. 2) Operation F1 (Op. F1) stands for the token-level F1 score for the predicted operation. 3) Step Success Rate (SSR). An interaction step is regarded as successful only if both the selected element and the predicted operation are correct. 4) Turn Success Rate (TSR). A conversation turn is regarded as successful only if all steps at this turn have succeeded.
